sentences.text:
In paragraph No.10 of Gargian Sudheeran's case (supra), this Court held that,
the legal position is emphatically clear on the point that if multiple first information reports by the same person against the same accused are permitted to be registered in respect of the same set of facts and allegations, the same would result in getting the accused entangled in multiple criminal proceedings for the same offences.
sentences._hearing_file: Xxx vs State Of Kerala on 3 April, 2025.json

sentences.text: Therefore, the registration of such multiple first information reports is 2025:KER:28916 nothing but an abuse of process of law and the same would not stand in the scrutiny of Articles 21 and 22 of the Constitution of India.
sentences._hearing_file: Xxx vs State Of Kerala on 3 April, 2025.json

sentences.text: In such cases, while permitting investigation in one FIR registered initially, other FIRs shall be quashed.
sentences._hearing_file: Xxx vs State Of Kerala on 3 April, 2025.json

sentences.text:
